annotations.title: Know Your Tool: check an MCP server before using it (free)

description: Free. Use before connecting to or installing an MCP server you have not used before, or to re-check one: connects once (no tool is called), scans tool descriptions for prompt-injection wording and invisible characters, lists tools that write, send, pay or run commands, checks the domain and publisher, and returns tools_sha256 (send it next time to catch a changed tool list). Decision allow, review or deny. Input: url, optional tools_sha256.
